newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS LEADS LITHUANIA SHARES HIGHER BY CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS LEADS LITHUANIA SHARES HIGHER BY CLOSE.

text.p: Hermis Bank shares jumped amid gains by the close on the Lithuanian bourse on Friday while brokers prepared for more modest rises next week.
"I'm neutral to optimistic," said one dealer, speaking of the prospects for the market next week.
The blue-chip official list gained 16.60 points to 1096.05 points by the close and the wider group-A index rose 17.87 points to 1861.28 points.
Central market turnover jumped to 1.7 million litas from 528,000 litas.
Hermis Bank shares, which rose to 265.50 litas from 250 litas, pulled up the official list index, amid a healthy 160,000 litas turnover.
Brokers are divided over whether Hermis shares will stay put or make a run for 300 litas.
"I think Hermis has the potential to reach 300 litas," one broker said.
Hermis saw 20,000 litas worth of block trades at 265 litas.
Vilniaus Bank held steady at 300 litas amid 768,000 litas central market turnover and block trades worth only 3,500 litas at 260 litas to 300 litas.
Brokers say Vilniaus Bank could make it to 315 litas next week.
Shares in Rokishkis Cheese inched up only slightly to 48 litas from 47.98 litas but brokers say they are headed for 50 litas in the coming weeks.
Group-A anchor Lithuanian Gas, back from a three-day suspension, advanced to 1.52 litas from 1.44 litas in central market turnover of 80,000 litas.
The shares were suspended as new isssue hit the market, which brought its share capital up to 339 million litas.
